metadata.description: 28 skills for screenwriting, visual composition and character writing: 26 screenwriting skills, imagedraf for cinematic prompts and character-shaping for memorable fictional characters.

plugins.name: screenwriting
plugins.description: 26 skills in four layers: general dramaturgy (workflow & story bible, structure, premise & theme, character & conflict, dialogue, scene craft, format & adaptation, Truby organic anatomy, genre anatomy); the medium layer (series: episode & season structure, series engine & bible, writers' room, half-hour comedy; stage: Chinese opera, banqiang and qupai methods with two full-script case libraries); tradition & trade (American case studies, Japanese, Korean & French, mainland-Chinese series practice, industry & business); and master corpora (Chekhov dramaturgy, Ozu screenplay style, Succession ensemble writing, television case studies); answers in the language you ask in (one Chinese source tree, no per-language forks)

plugins.name: composition
plugins.description: Chinese visual composition and cinematic prompt direction using imagedraf; framing, lighting, color, materials, atmosphere and constraints for image and video prompts.

plugins.name: character
plugins.description: Character writing based on the user's Chinese course: causal biography, action, flaws, contrast, multiple viewpoints, values, distinctive behavior, repetition and emotional subtext.
